_comment: Model slugs: stable provider/alias names that resolve to a concrete model id and pick the harness that runs it. Wire quirks (base URL, model prefix, effort remap, API key env) stay in providers.json, named here by `profile`. Labels and pricing stay in models.json, keyed by the resolved id. Adapted from Pullfrog's model registry (models.ts, effort.ts), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Pullfrog, Inc.

_fields.providers.<name>.profile: The providers.json profile the API harness uses for this provider's slugs. Its api_key_env is the API credential.
_fields.providers.<name>.harness: The vendor's own harness, used when one of harness_env is set.
_fields.providers.<name>.harness_env: Credentials that send this provider's slugs to its vendor harness.
_fields.slugs.<slug>.resolve: The concrete model id, as models.json keys it.
_fields.slugs.<slug>.effort: Effort levels the model accepts, cheapest first. Omitted: the model has no effort control.
_fields.slugs.<slug>.fallback: Slug tried once when the model is missing or unavailable. Same provider.
_fields.slugs.<slug>.cheap: Cheaper slug for the indexing and security passes when they have no model of their own. Same provider.
